_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json. Overlays the existing native ReceiptDetail page (mergePages replaces by id, mirrors AfspraakDetail).
_meta.description: Swaps the native ReceiptDetail (type: detail) for a custom ReceiptCapture component (REQ-RXC-003): per-field docudesk-extraction confidence, correction, and re-request on top of the same fields the native page already showed.

pages.title: Receipt
pages._note: Overlays the base ReceiptDetail (type: detail) with a bespoke component so per-field docudesk-extraction confidence, correction, and the re-request action can render — none of which the generic field-list detail page supports (REQ-RXC-003/004/005).
